title: Figure 26. Titan IV Breakup Percentages (line graph)
description: Line graph of Breakup Percent (%) versus Failure Time (sec), 0–280 s, for the Titan IV launch vehicle, with curves for q-alpha = 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 deg-lb/ft². Accompanying text (Section 6.4, Shaping Constants for Titan IV) states 290,000 simulations were run between programming time of 18 seconds and staging at 300 seconds. Captioned "Figure 26. Titan IV Breakup Percentages".
